scope.details: One seed, 36 tasks, all zero success. Honest smoke qualifiers are present; navigation success and ablation claims remain unsupported.

findings.title: Resume ignores saved phase and defaults final checkpoints to initial empty environment
findings.impact: Triggered by resuming a final checkpoint without --phase final; not exercised in smoke.
findings.action: Infer phase from checkpoint when unspecified; make incompatible explicit overrides fail or explicit.

findings.title: Dataset collector samples Gaussian actions whereas official collection is deterministic
findings.action: Use deterministic mean actions for source-matched collection, or label stochastic collection as an intentional variant; preserve old datasets.

findings.title: Offline LSTM learning rate is 3e-4 rather than upstream 1e-4
findings.action: Use upstream value or disclose the deviation.

findings.title: Four tiled parity rows and old checkpoint provenance do not establish broad camera or historical source equivalence
findings.action: Constrain existing claims; preserve future parity producer/capture identities and source version without retroactively certifying old runs.

findings.title: Third mission orientation samples y in [0,40] instead of [0,34]
findings.action: Restore source interval or explicitly disclose the wider scene adaptation.

findings.title: Tracker and results-document references lag completed smoke artifacts
